keyword: two to three floor concrete pump

title.en: Which printed window fits this check: which pump is already tied to a 2–3 floor house
title.zh: 这一问只对一个窗口：两三层房屋已经写在哪一台泵上

description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Electric 15, and only inside the cells already printed. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists it for rural self-built houses, small sites and secondary structure: 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m, horizontal 60–80 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, pipe 100–125 mm, 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm and 450 kg. Taken from the printed row: The site’s Electric 15 application note already names two-to-three-floor houses next to that vertical window. This page does not add a storey height and leaves that cell blank for an outlet pressure, because the specification table does not list one.
description.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。电动15，而且只能停在已经印出的格子里。邢台河北品锦机械把它列为农村自建房、小型工地和二次结构：15 kW、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、骨料 1–3 cm、管径 100–125 mm、外形 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm、450 kg。本站电动15应用说明已经把两三层房屋放在那个垂直窗口旁边。本页不另加层高，也不印出口压力，因为规格表没有这一格。

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Terminology” from “Three-phase electric power”, then stays with the cells already published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The published Electric 15 note places two-to-three-floor houses beside 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal. This page does not add a storey height and leaves that cell blank for an outlet pressure, because the specification table does not list one. Taken from the printed row: Electric 10 Series shares the rural sentence and 15 kW, but it prints 25 m horizontal, 21 m³/h and 400 kg, and it does not print a vertical cell. Keep this cell as published. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It is already in the published Electric 15 application note. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power
body.zh: 本节保留《Three-phase electric power》的标题“术语”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。已发布的电动15说明把两三层房屋和 15 kW、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m 放在一起。本页不把楼层换算成米。按邢台表上的原文理解：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-phase_electric_power

body.en: The section shape comes from “History” in “Three-phase electric power”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. This page does not convert floors into metres. Taken from the printed row: Horizontal beyond 60–80 m, vertical beyond 15–20 m, or stone outside 1–3 cm is no longer Electric 15. Keep this cell as published. Do not move the two-to-three-floor sentence onto that row. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Read it in the Xingtai table. This page does not extend it with a metres-per-floor figure.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Three-phase electric power》的“沿革”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：电动15，而且只能停在已经印出的格子里。邢台河北品锦机械把它列为农村自建房、小型工地和二次结构：15 kW、8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、骨料 1–3 cm、管径 100–125 mm、外形 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm、450 kg。本站电动15应用说明已经把两三层房屋放在那个垂直窗口旁边。本页不另加层高，也不印出口压力，因为规格表没有这一格。目录里已经写着：没有。表上是功率、输送量、垂直、水平、骨料、管径、外形和 450 kg。

body.en: “Three-phase electric power” breaks its subject at “Principle”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: Electric 15, and only inside the cells already printed. Keep this cell as published. A building line that needs 120 m / 40 m and an 80 mm pipe is Electric 20, which is not named as a rural self-built model. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Send measured vertical and horizontal metres and the stone size. Read it in the Xingtai table. No. Taken from the printed row: The commercial sentence is on Electric 20 and the larger electric trailer pumps.
body.zh: 《Three-phase electric power》在“原理”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。目录里已经写着：水平超出 60–80 m、垂直超出 15–20 m，或石子不在 1–3 cm，就不再是电动15。需要 120 m / 40 m 和 80 mm 管的建筑管路是电动20，它没有被写成农村自建房型号。没有电网：农村柴油泵印的是 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m。这一格照已印出的读：不是。它已经在已发布的电动15应用说明里。本页不用每层米数去延伸它。

body.en: Borrow “Advantages and disadvantages” from “Three-phase electric power” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists it for rural self-built houses, small sites and secondary structure: 15 kW, 8–10 m³/h, vertical 15–20 m, horizontal 60–80 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, pipe 100–125 mm, 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm and 450 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No grid: the rural diesel pump prints 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m horizontal and 10–30 m vertical. Read it in the Xingtai table. A floor count alone is not the specification. Taken from the printed row: The table prints power, output, vertical, horizontal, aggregate, pipe, size and 450 kg. Keep this cell as published. Electric 15 is the rural and small-site row.
body.zh: 把《Three-phase electric power》的“优点与缺点”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。它不是对每一栋这样的房子的承诺，也不是把其他型号变成楼层区间的公式。电动10系列共用农村那句话和 15 kW，但它印的是水平 25 m、21 m³/h 和 400 kg，而且没有垂直格。先不要把两三层这句话挪到那一行。旁边那一台不在这句话里。商业这句话在电动20和更大的电动拖泵上。电动15是农村和小型工地行。

body.en: The reference page “Three-phase electric power” uses “Generation and distribution” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The site’s Electric 15 application note already names two-to-three-floor houses next to that vertical window. Read it in the Xingtai table. It is not a promise for every house of that description, and it is not a formula that turns other models into floor bands. Taken from the printed row: Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Keep this cell as published. No.
body.zh: 来源页《Three-phase electric power》用“发电分布”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请发量到的垂直和水平米数以及石子粒径。只有层数不是规格。

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Terminology” — Does Electric 15 list outlet pressure?
question.zh: “术语”旁边仍要印着的是什么：电动15列出出口压力了吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No. The table prints power, output, vertical, horizontal, aggregate, pipe, size and 450 kg.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。没有。表上是功率、输送量、垂直、水平、骨料、管径、外形和 450 kg。

question.en: “History” does not change the check: Is the two-to-three-floor line a new calculation?
question.zh: “沿革”不改这一问：两三层是新算出来的吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. No. It is already in the published Electric 15 application note. This page does not extend it with a metres-per-floor figure.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：不是。它已经在已发布的电动15应用说明里。本页不用每层米数去延伸它。

question.en: Is this a commercial building pump, once the outline says “Principle”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“原理”时，这是商业建筑泵吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: The commercial sentence is on Electric 20 and the larger electric trailer pumps. Electric 15 is the rural and small-site row.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：商业这句话在电动20和更大的电动拖泵上。电动15是农村和小型工地行。
